scammer. This scammer developer has deleted my comments multiple times, which shows that the negative reviews here are fake and that a large number of negative reviews have been deleted. Below, I will once again summarize the truth for everyone:

This app is another classic bait-and-switch scam. It uses the promise of "lifetime free access" as bait to boost download numbers and manipulate ratings, only to slap existing lifetime users with extra charges once new features are added.

This is hands down the worst AI chat app I’ve ever used. Its responses are either refusals, "unable to answer," or just extremely poor quality. I kept waiting for updates to improve the experience, but I never expected the team behind it to be so deceptive.

In the past, they tried to charge lifetime users extra for the web search feature and only backed down after a user boycott. Now, I’ve noticed that the new file upload feature forces you to log in to use it. On top of that, the newly added image and video generation features consume "credits," which lifetime users have to pay extra for (aside from a small one-time gift).

To make matters worse, despite having lifetime access, I can’t even log in using my Apple ID it keeps saying "… invalid." I’m still not entirely sure how their convoluted charging system even works.
